package.description: A code editor for humanoid apes and grumpy toads

en-US.description: A code editor for humanoid apes and grumpy toads
en-US.longDescription: Gram is a powerful and modern source code editor. It features solid performance and is highly configurable, yet comes with batteries included out of the box. Gram supports many popular programming languages and file formats, and can use Zed extensions to support additional languages. Other features include built-in documentation, debugger support via the DAP protocol, source control using git and more. Gram started as a fork of the Zed editor.
en-US.name: Gram

zh-CN.description: 为人类猿和暴躁蟾蜍打造的代码编辑器。
zh-CN.longDescription: Gram 是一款强大的现代源代码编辑器。它性能出色、可高度配置，同时开箱即用地内置了大量功能。Gram 支持许多流行的编程语言和文件格式，并可以使用 Zed 扩展来支持更多语言。其他功能包括内置文档、通过 DAP 协议提供的调试器支持、基于 git 的版本控制等。Gram 最初是 Zed 编辑器的一个分支。
